actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
Creates a lead form on a Facebook Page.
Website the "thank you" screen links to after submission. Required by Facebook.
Form language, e.g. "EN_US" or "DE_DE". Defaults to the Page locale.
Internal name of the form, shown in Ads Manager.
Facebook Page ID, e.g. "104857839123456". Use List Pages to find it.
Text of the privacy policy link. Defaults to "Privacy Policy".
Link to the advertiser privacy policy. Required by Facebook.

JSON array of questions. Standard fields only need a type, e.g. [{"type":"FULL_NAME"},{"type":"EMAIL"},{"type":"PHONE"}]. Custom questions use {"type":"CUSTOM","key":"budget","label":"What is your budget?"}, with "options":[{"key":"low","value":"Under $1k"}] for multiple choice.
Gets the Facebook user the connection belongs to.
actions.facebook_leads_get_lead.props.le: Lead ID, e.g. "987654321098765". Use List Leads to find it.
actions.facebook_leads_get_lead_form.des: Gets a lead form, including its questions.
actions.facebook_leads_get_lead_form.pro: Lead form ID, e.g. "1234567890123456". Use List Lead Forms to find it.
actions.facebook_leads_list_lead_forms.d: Lists the lead forms of a Facebook Page.
actions.facebook_leads_list_lead_forms.p: Facebook Page ID, e.g. "104857839123456". Use List Pages to find it.
actions.facebook_leads_list_leads.descri: Lists the leads submitted to a lead form.
Only leads submitted after this time (ISO 8601).
Only leads submitted before this time (ISO 8601).

Lead form ID, e.g. "1234567890123456". Use List Lead Forms to find it.
actions.facebook_leads_list_pages.descri: Lists the Facebook Pages the connected user manages.
actions.facebook_leads_update_lead_form_: Archives or reactivates a lead form.
Lead form ID, e.g. "1234567890123456". Use List Lead Forms to find it.
ID of the Facebook Page that owns the form. Use List Pages to find it.

triggers.new_lead.description: Triggers when someone fills in one of your lead ad forms.
triggers.new_lead.props.form.description: Pick one form, or All Forms for leads from every form on the Page.
triggers.new_lead.props.info.description: Runs once for each new lead. Test Trigger loads recent leads from the chosen form, or from the first form on the Page that has any.
triggers.new_lead.props.page.description: The Facebook Page that runs your lead ads.
